metadata.description: A single-skill marketplace distributing the Resume Tailor skill for Claude Code.

plugins.name: resume-tailor
plugins.description: Tailor one-page LaTeX resumes per job description from verified accomplishment notes built from your connected repos (local or GitHub) or your own descriptions. Batch multi-JD tailoring, cover letters and question answers in your voice, deterministic keyword coverage, an interactive application tracker dashboard, and drop-in custom templates. Plus live job search (newest-first or best-fit), browser auto-apply via Claude in Chrome (semi-manual or automatic) with a battle-tested portal playbook, and a settings profile for the facts forms always ask.
